q: A rank-one MPT is defined by:
opts: A sequence of Rohlin towers (B_n,...,T^{h_n-1}B_n) with μ(B_n)→0 that fill X asymptotically
exp: Rank-one: the system can be built by successively refining single 'Rohlin towers' that cover the space. Examples: Chacón system, staircase transformation. Rank-one systems form a large class; the isomorphism problem within rank-one mixing systems is open.
